title: Migrate settlement reads from raw_props to provider_offers
objective: Migrate SettlementAgent game-result reads from the deprecated raw_props table to the canonical provider_offers table
summary: The SettlementAgent currently reads game results from raw_props for grading. This sprint migrates those reads to provider_offers (canonical ingestion table) and ensures settlement writes still go through lifecycle adapters.
acceptanceCriteria: SettlementAgent reads from provider_offers instead of raw_props
Lifecycle gate passes in strict mode
Runtime smoke test confirms settlement flow
No direct writes to raw_props from any agent
notes: raw_props compatibility views may still exist for read-only legacy paths
